naslov: AI Wars Ep. 7: Anthropic moves 2x faster, investors balk at $1.5T
opis:
METR, a nonprofit that independently tests AI models, estimates Anthropic's models have progressed about 1.9x faster since October 2025, with about 80% of that speedup coming from AI helping with research, though Anthropic redacted the strongest evidence. Meanwhile, investors are pushing back on Anthropic's $1.5 trillion IPO valuation, and OpenAI raised another $11 billion at $1.25 trillion, below the $1.4 trillion it hoped for.

naslov: What is Mixture of Experts (MoE)? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
A mixture of experts (MoE) is one big AI model built from many smaller specialist parts. A router picks only a few of them to handle each token, so the model gets big-model smarts at a lower running cost. Example: Thinking Machines' new Inkling 2 Small has 594 billion parameters, but only 17 billion are active for each token.
